name: bharatpulse
description: BharatPulse: civic early-warning for water-supply failures. Complaints become incidents.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bharatpulse/engine && npm run build -w @bharatpulse/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @bharatpulse/engine && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @bharatpulse/engine && npm run dev -w @bharatpulse/server
scripts.eval: npm run build -w @bharatpulse/engine && npm run eval -w @bharatpulse/server
scripts.neo4j:smoke: npm run build -w @bharatpulse/engine && npm run neo4j:smoke -w @bharatpulse/server
scripts.sarvam:smoke: npm run build -w @bharatpulse/engine && npm run sarvam:smoke -w @bharatpulse/server
